title: Health, Wealth, and Children
coreMove: Recognize a real life concern and respond with care before advice.
sourcePressure: Recurring human concerns can deepen conversation naturally when handled with care rather than intrusion.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Using personal topics as invasive shortcuts to intimacy.

hook: You need better networking, not more contacts
